description: Merge one loser contact into one winner contact using explicit contact locators.

loser.description: Loser contact. Provide contactId or identity.

now.description: Optional merge timestamp. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

winner.description: Winner contact. Provide contactId or identity.

name: merge_contacts
